Here are some links to two of my latest research papers. These are temporary free access links:

- [Rethinking local spectral modelling: From per-query refitting to model libraries](https://kwnsfk27.r.eu-west-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fauthors.elsevier.com%2Fa%2F1nB8W_4mG-X6u/1/0102019e74a98917-a5f27f99-f893-4eaa-8b16-e0093ee8178b-000000/21mjSH7OR8yf0uNK98WoaEpEqzM=473): This paper describes a new concept to build spectral libraries of models.

- [When spectral libraries are too complex to search: Evolutionary subset selection for domain-adaptive calibration](https://authors.elsevier.com/a/1n7Y4_4mG-X6P): This paper introduces a non-linear approach to search large spectral libraries and identify the most relevant data for a specific prediction context.
